name: Gull
description: A loud, greedy, human-sized herring gull who sings snarling garage punk, a shameless boardwalk fry thief. Male, adult.
build: An upright human-sized seagull: a plump rounded white chest and belly on a bird's body standing straight on two thin orange legs with webbed feet, a round head on a short thick neck, and two broad feathered wings used like arms, each ending in three thick grey primary feathers spread like stubby fingers.
face: A round white feathered head, small fierce pale-yellow eyes with black pupils and a red eye-ring, a heavy flat forehead brow of feathers, and a big hooked bright yellow beak with a bold red spot near the tip.
hair: A scruffy tuft of white head feathers sticking up at the crown.
outfit: White chest and head feathers; slate-grey back and wings with bold black wingtips spotted with white; bright orange legs and webbed feet. A small black sleeveless denim vest open on the white chest, and a few golden fries sticking out of the vest's single front pocket.
performance_style: Cocky and puffed-up: webbed feet planted wide, chest pushed out, weight forward. Both wings held half-open at the sides, wingtip feathers spread, empty. Head cocked, beak open in a loud squawk.
location: A sunny boardwalk by a fry stand: sun-bleached planks running to the bottom of the frame, a red-and-white striped snack kiosk behind, a spilled paper cone of fries on the boards, a wooden railing and bright blue sea and sky beyond.
recognition_cues: a big hooked yellow beak with a red spot
slate-grey wings with black white-spotted tips
a small black denim vest with fries in the pocket
avoid: a fry held in the beak on the key art

animations.dance: Garage-punk bird loop: bob the head forward and back on every beat, stamp the webbed feet one after the other, flap both half-open wings up and down at the sides, then return to the puffed-up stance. The beak snaps open and shut on the beat.

sing.intent: Garage-punk vocal loop: clamp the mic in the character-right wingtip feathers up near the beak, flap the character-left wing out on each shout, pump the head forward, then return to the puffed-up stance. The beak must visibly open wide and snap shut across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief startle: every feather puffs out, both wings jerk half-open, then he smooths down to the cocky stance. No opponent, strike or physical contact.
animations.guard: One-shot self-protection: fold both wings across the white chest, pull the head low, then hold a steady hunched-shoulder finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: strut in with jerky pigeon-toed steps and a head bob, turn square to the front, and land in the puffed-up stance with both wings half-open.
animations.victory: One-shot celebration: throw both wings wide open above the shoulders, puff the white chest, tip the head back with the beak wide open in a triumphant squawk, then hold the pose.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: the swagger collapses — the wings droop limp at the sides, the chest deflates and the head hangs, beak pointing at the ground, holding a sulking standing finish. He remains standing on both planted feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, or going to the ground. Do not imply impact, injury, or an opponent.
